_readme: Edit these numbers to change how the scanner judges and alerts. All money figures are AFTER fees. Percentages are written as numbers (3 means 3%).

verdict._notes: lockedMarginPct/evMarginPct = how far above the T-bill rate the annualized return must be ('clearly beats'). minHoldDays floors the hold time so hourly markets don't annualize into fantasy numbers. feeRoundTo: Kalshi rounds fee+cost up to $0.0001 (July 2026 schedule); set 0.01 to be extra conservative.

alerts._notes: tier1 = locked-in arbitrage: 3% per 3 months = 12%/yr AND must also beat T-bills + lockedMarginPct. tier2 = positive-EV-can-lose: 10% per 3 months = 40%/yr. minProfit stops emails about pennies (same $5 as the card verdict). Set enabled=false to stop all emails.
